summary.name: BrainSoup
summary.one_liner: BrainSoup is a Nurgo Software product, and this page is its help center index listing popular support articles about setting up and using it.
use_cases: setting up local LLMs with BrainSoup
summary.what_it_does: This page is a help-center collection of the most popular support articles for BrainSoup. The visible article titles cover connecting local LLM servers such as Ollama and LM Studio, Ollama context length (num_ctx) settings, the default tools available to BrainSoup agents, and what a .ignore file does. It also includes a welcome article and a pricing question. The page text itself contains only titles, so the answers are not visible here.
notable: Documents local LLM integration with Ollama and LM Studio
Covers agent default tools and .ignore file behavior
Part of Nurgo Software's product help center alongside VoxAction, AquaSnap, TidyTabs and GameLibBooster
caveats: Page text contains only article titles, so pricing and platform details are not confirmed here
